translated: Back then, I couldn't go to school or play with everyone, so being alone just made me overthink things.
I kept wondering, what if everyone drifts apart...
and ends up going somewhere far away?
I was always so scared and lonely.
I guess I'm just remembering how I felt back then.
Saki...
It's weird for me to feel this way.
I know things are different now.
I really do.
Even if you know that, it's not strange to feel this way.
Because those feelings repeated so many times that they became a part of Saki.
A part of me...
Exactly.
So there's no need to reject that part of yourself.
I'm sure there are things you've achieved precisely because you had those feelings.
Things I've achieved?
Like starting Leo/need with the four of you, or using those experiences to write songs that comfort others.
So please, don't think of those feelings as weird.
Even if you can't fully reconcile with them yet, I don't think you need to rush.
MEIKO...
You're right.
I might still feel uneasy from time to time,
but that's also a part of me, so I want to try accepting it bit by bit.
I really do.
But if things ever get painful again, please rely on me.
There might not be much I can do, but I'm always here to listen.
Thank you, MEIKO.
I'm lonely.
But why?
I thought I understood the reason, but I feel like there's still a lingering haze.
